title: Nebula Reach Dimension
description: A breathtaking cosmic dimension comprised of star-dust islands floating in a glowing lilac nebula, accessible via the Celestial Altar fusion gate.
author: Aetheria Creator
behaviorBullets: Low gravity effect active throughout the entire dimension.
Beds exploded when slept in, releasing nebula dust.
Cosmic storms occur periodically, charging latent crystal blocks.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The Nebula Reach is an endgame dimension designed to challenge players with high-level environmental hazards and powerful cosmic entities. It is a completely custom dimension containing unique gravitational dynamics and stargaze blocks.

sections.title: Atmosphere & Gravity
sections.content: Due to the lack of a dense core, Nebula Reach has extremely light gravity. Jumping allows you to ascend 4-5 blocks high, but falling from high places is still dangerous unless you possess slow falling boots or celestial armor.

sections.title: How to Access
sections.content: To enter the Nebula Reach, players must assemble a **Celestial Altar** using celestial stone and a crystal core. Channeling energy into the altar with an elemental wand will tear open the cosmic portal.
